# Amount with Currency

## Summary
Base-realm money field pairing a numeric amount with an ISO currency. Lives
at `https://cardstack.com/base/amount-with-currency` (default export
`AmountWithCurrency`).

## API
- `amount` — NumberField
- `currency` — a `CurrencyField` (`{ code }`, e.g. USD, MYR) with a picker

## Usage
```ts
import AmountWithCurrency from 'https://cardstack.com/base/amount-with-currency';

@field dealValue = contains(AmountWithCurrency);
```
Renders the amount formatted with its currency. For plain unitless numbers
use NumberField; for percentages use the Percentage field.
